cues: Rakesh takes charge of his father's diet.
After a bout of illness from halwa and cream, the famous doctor forbids anything rich.
Fried food goes, then sweets, then everything the old man enjoys.
Varma bribes his grandsons to buy him jalebis, and is caught; Rakesh warns of cholera and typhoid.
What is left: dry bread, boiled lentils, boiled vegetables, and cereal weighed on scales.
